description: This file defines a PHP class 'FilterProjectEvent' within the 'Goteo' project, specifically in the 'Console\Event' namespace. The class encapsulates event-related data and methods for handling project filtering logic, such as retrieving days since certain project milestones and project contract status.

classes.name: FilterProjectEvent
classes.description: An event class used within the Goteo console event system to handle project filtering, providing methods to retrieve project age in days, success, funding status, and contract status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with a Project object.

methods.name: getDays
methods.description: Calculates days elapsed since the project's published date.

methods.name: getDaysSucceeded
methods.description: Calculates days since the project's success date or passed date based on project rounds.

methods.name: getDaysFunded
methods.description: Calculates days since the project was funded or passed, depending on the project round.

methods.name: getContractStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current contract status for the project.
